connectors.name: 2x3 pin header
connectors.orderNote: Pin numbers 1, 3, 5, 6 printed; followed them (1 bottom-right, 5 top-right, 6 top-left); unnumbered holes 2 and 4 inferred as bottom-left and middle-left

unreadable: Positions 2 and 4 (left column, bottom and middle holes): no label or pin number printed
uncertain: Pin numbers 2 and 4 are not printed; their physical positions were inferred from the odd/even column pattern (1,3,5 right column; 6 top-left).
Descriptions ('Ground', '3.3V power input', 'Monitoring chip SDA/SCL pin') come from a separate legend table beside the board, matched by name.
